# Character Dossier & Modular Sheets

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
from sr6core.character_manager import CharacterManager
from sr6core.exporters.vtt_text import (
    export_base_sheet,
    export_contacts_sheet,
    export_combat_sheet,
    export_inventory_sheet,
    export_vehicles_sheet,
    export_powers_sheet,
)

cm = CharacterManager()
char_data = cm.get_character_data("velvet") or {}

base_txt = export_base_sheet(char_data, char_repo_path=".")
combat_txt = export_combat_sheet(char_data)
contacts_txt = export_contacts_sheet(char_data)
inventory_txt = export_inventory_sheet(char_data)
vehicles_txt = export_vehicles_sheet(char_data)
powers_txt = export_powers_sheet(char_data)
```

::: {.callout-note}
### Downloadable Character Sheets & Card Decks
* **Printable Index Card Deck (4.25" x 5.5" / 4" x 6" Laserjet PDF)**: [velvet_cards_deck.pdf](../output/pdf/velvet_cards_deck.pdf)
* **Printable Base Sheet (1-Page PDF)**: [velvet_base_sheet.pdf](../output/pdf/velvet_base_sheet.pdf)
* **VTT & CommLink6 Saves**: [velvet.xml](../output/vtt/velvet.xml) | [velvet.json](../output/vtt/velvet.json)
* **Plain-Text Modular Exports**: [Base Sheet](../output/text/velvet_base.txt) | [Combat](../output/text/velvet_combat.txt) | [Inventory](../output/text/velvet_inventory.txt) | [Powers](../output/text/velvet_powers.txt) | [Vehicles](../output/text/velvet_vehicles.txt) | [Contacts](../output/text/velvet_contacts.txt) | [Ledger](../output/text/velvet_ledger.txt)
:::
